newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OUB sees block trades at just below S$10.
newsitem.headline: OUB sees block trades at just below S$10.

text.p: The foreign tranche of Overseas Union Bank Ltd shares saw several blocks crossed in Monday morning trade, dealers said.
A Singapore broker said all 1.48 million shares were crossed off the market at various prices between Singapore $9.87 and $9.95.
At 0240 GMT, the counter was quoted at S$9.85/S$10.00.
The bank proposed a 1-for-5 rights issue in its 1996 results to raise some S$700 million to boost its capital base.
Some broking housings, including SBC Warburg, have recommended a buy for the stock as they still see attractive earnings growth despite the dilution from the proposed rights issue.
